title: Continuous Flow Synthesis of Urea‐Containing Compound Libraries Based on the Piperidin‐4‐one Scaffold
abstract: The advantages of performing reactions in continuous flow vs. the classic batch processes render flow chemistry a suitable technique for library synthesis. Inspired by our recent work to create fluorine‐containing nitrogen heterocycles and by the potential of the urea group in drug design, we herewith describe the combination of both aspects in the continuous flow synthesis of two libraries of urea derivatives based on the piperidin‐4‐one scaffold.
